name: Vanessa Twanbach
original_name: ヴァネッサ ツアンバッハ
source: One of the twins who share a conscience because it was intended for one body, but got separated. Both she and her sister hunt demons along with Reginald.
translation: One of the twins who share a conscience because it was intended for one body, but got separated. Both she and her sister hunt demons along with Reginald.
